```{r, message=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(spdep)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(spatialreg)
library(viridis)
library(data.table)
library(spectralGP)
```


```{r}
# Import the data
pres_data_path <- "C:/Users/aasie/OneDrive/Documentos/GIS713-Homework3/Data/2016_US_County_Level_Presidential_Results.csv"
acs_county_data_path <- "C:/Users/aasie/OneDrive/Documentos/GIS713-Homework3/Data/acs2015_county_data.csv"
election_results <- fread(pres_data_path)
acs_counties <- fread(acs_county_data_path)
head(election_results)
head(acs_counties)
```
```{r}
# Look at column names in the datasets 
colnames(acs_counties)
colnames(election_results)
print(nrow(acs_counties))
print(nrow(election_results))
```


```{r}
# Remove non-CONUS counties from both datasets 
acs_counties <- acs_counties[!State == "Alaska" & 
                            !State == "Hawaii" & 
                            !State == "Puerto Rico"]
election_results <- election_results[!state_abbr == "AK" & 
                                    !state_abbr == "HI" & 
                                    !state_abbr == "PR"]
print(nrow(acs_counties))
print(nrow(election_results))
```


```{r}
# Spatial join between the two datasets
election_counties <- merge(acs_counties,
                           election_results,
                           by.x="CensusId", 
                           by.y="combined_fips", 
                           all.x=TRUE, 
                           all.y=TRUE
                           )
head(election_counties)
colnames(election_counties)
```

```{r}
# Create new variables 
election_counties[, frac_non_citizen := 1 - (Citizen / TotalPop)][,
                  frac_women := Women/TotalPop][,
                  frac_nonwhite := 1 - (White/TotalPop)][,
                  frac_voting := total_votes/TotalPop]
head(election_counties)
```

```{r}
# Subset only to specified variables
election_counties_subset <- election_counties[, .SD, .SDcols = c(
    "CensusId", "State", "County", 
    "per_dem", "per_gop", "frac_voting", 
    "frac_women", "frac_nonwhite", "frac_non_citizen", 
    "Income", "Poverty", "ChildPoverty", "Professional"
    )]
colnames(election_counties_subset)
```
